warnings: Two parts: ฐานรากแบบที่ 1 (pile footing F1 — plan, section) and the column table ขยายเสา C1/C2/C3 by level (multi-level schedule drawn as sections; one entry per level per section 8).
C3 has no upper part ('-' in the table): it stops at the ground-beam top (หลังคานชั้น 1).

Pile notes (รายการประกอบแบบฐานราก): prestressed solid square pile 0.22x0.22 m, 21.00 m, 2 jointed segments, safe load >= 25 t/pile, มอก. 396-2549; boring test 1 hole; driving criteria by Danish / Engineering News formula, SF 2.5 (Hiley formula forbidden).
The cap section prints '8-DB16mm(เหล็กยืน)' on the cap's vertical bars while the C1 stub below the beam is 8-DB12 in the column table — both kept as printed (cap's bar in additional_bars), flagged.
The mat is '2x2-DB12mm#' -> main_bar.count 4 (two each way); the edge tie '2-DB12mm(รัดรอบ)' -> stirrup.count 2, no spacing.
